snippet.title: Clawed - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Embark on a covert mission to the dinosaur theme park Prehistoria, where you must explore the park's grounds to scavenge supplies, solve puzzles, and fight your way through diverse biomes, underground tunnels and deadly enclosures. But beware, you are not the apex predator here.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3394840/Clawed/
